verdict.rationale: Neon has a dedicated first-party docs page for the pgvector extension on its serverless Postgres platform, so embeddings and similarity search can run inside the existing database without a separate vector store. The pack gives only the page title, so depth of support cannot be confirmed. Missing for 10: documented details on vector index types (HNSW/IVFFlat), distance operators and performance limits, and independent or hands-on confirmation of vector search on Neon.
